meta.name: add-dashboard
meta.description: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw. Installs @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard and a pusher that sends periodic JSON snapshots.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 NanoClaw 添加监控仪表盘并推送数据快照
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 NanoClaw 并需要可视化运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Add a monitoring dashboard and push data snapshots to NanoClaw
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and need to visualize its runtime status

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会给你的 NanoClaw 项目安装监控仪表盘：加一个小插件，让它每 60 秒把数据库快照、每 2 秒把日志发给本地看板，并显示会话、token 用量、实时日志等页面。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 添加监控仪表盘、看板，或提到“/add-dashboard”时触发。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加一个监控仪表盘。
say.note: 安装依赖并配置启动代码。

say.text: 用 /add-dashboard 给项目装上实时看板。
say.note: 复制 pusher 并添加环境变量。

say.text: 在 NanoClaw 里开启日志实时刷新页面。
say.note: 启动后访问本地 dashboard 页面。

howto.what_en: Claude sets up a local monitoring dashboard for NanoClaw: installs the dashboard package and a pusher sending a JSON DB snapshot every 60s and log tails every 2s, showing sessions, token usage, and live logs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add a monitoring dashboard or live dashboard to NanoClaw, or mentions /add-dashboard.

say_en.text: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Installs the package and wires startup.

say_en.text: Use /add-dashboard to set up the live dashboard.
say_en.note: Copies the pusher and adds env vars.

say_en.text: Turn on the real-time log page for NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Open the local dashboard in a browser.
